For purposes of this section, 4 “antisemitism” means the same as defined in section 216F.1. 5 EXPLANATION 6 The inclusion of this explanation does not constitute agreement with 7 the explanation’s substance by the members of the general assembly. 8 This bill requires the state board of education to submit 9 an annual report to the general assembly and governor by 10 October 1 of each year, identifying each complaint or incident 11 of antisemitism that occurred during the prior academic year 12 at each community college, institution of higher education 13 under the control of the state board of regents, and public 14 school district. The bill requires the report to include the 15 findings and outcomes of any investigations conducted. The 16 bill requires the board of directors of each community college, 17 the state board of regents, and the board of directors of each 18 public school district to submit a report to the state board 19 of education by September 1 of each year identifying each 20 complaint or incident of antisemitism that occurred during the 21 prior academic year at the respective institution for use in 22 the state board of education’s annual report. 23 The bill also requires the state board of regents to conduct 24 an annual review of policies related to antisemitic actions and 25 speech at regents institutions, and to include such findings 26 in the report. 27 -2- LSB 5719XL (2) 91 mb/jh 2/ 2
